question: Which of the following athletes was NOT part of the Indian 4 times 100 m relay team that set a new national record at the National Relay Carnival, 2025?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Neeraj Chopra**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Neeraj Chopra**, India's celebrated javelin thrower, was not a part of the Indian **4 × 100 m relay team** at the **National Relay Carnival, 2025**. He specializes in individual field events rather than track relay races.
 
• The Indian **4 × 100 m relay team**, which set a new **national record** in 2025, included athletes like **Animesh Kujur, Manikanta Hoblidar, and Amlan Borgohain**, who are renowned sprinters excelling in relay races.
 
• **Neeraj Chopra** is primarily known for his achievements in the sport of javelin throw, including his gold medal win at the **Tokyo Olympics 2020**, making him one of India's most successful track and field athletes.
 
• Relay teams consist of four sprinters who specialize in running short distances and are trained for baton exchanges, a key component of relay races. Neeraj Chopra's expertise lies in the javelin throw, which is a field event, not a track relay event.
 
• The inclusion of sprinters like **Animesh Kujur, Manikanta Hoblidar**, and **Amlan Borgohain** in the relay team highlights their competence and specialization in the track events, whereas **Neeraj Chopra**'s absence is in line with his focus on field events.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Neeraj Chopra:**

 
 
• **Age:** Born on **24 December 1997**, Neeraj Chopra is an Indian track and field athlete specializing in the javelin throw.
 
• **Achievements:** He won the **gold medal** at the **Tokyo Olympics 2020**, becoming the first Indian to win an Olympic gold medal in athletics.
 
• **Recognition:** Neeraj has received several awards, including the **Major Dhyan Chand Khel Ratna Award**, India's highest sporting honor.
 
• **Specialization:** Javelin throw, a field event that involves throwing a spear-like equipment over a distance.
 
 
 
• **Amlan Borgohain:**
 
 
• **Role:** An Indian sprinter known for his expertise in short-distance track events such as the 100m and 200m races.
 
• **Achievements:** Holds the national record in the **200m sprint** as of 2022.
 
• **Specialization:** A regular participant in relay teams, showcasing his skills in baton exchanges and sprinting.
 
 
 
• **Relay Races:**
 
 
• **Definition:** A track event where four athletes run equal segments of a race while passing a baton.
 
• **Key Skills:** Speed, coordination, and precision in baton exchanges are critical to relay success.
 
• **India's Achievements:** Indian relay teams have consistently improved their performance in international and national competitions, setting records like the one at the **National Relay Carnival, 2025**.
 
 
 
• **Track vs. Field Events:**
 
 
• **Track Events:** Include races such as sprints, middle-distance, and long-distance events.
 
• **Field Events:** Include javelin throw, shot put, long jump, and other events that focus on physical strength and technique.
 
• **Neeraj Chopra's Domain:** As a field athlete, Neeraj excels in javelin throw, which is distinct from track events like relay races.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Indian Relay Team:** The team composition for relay races is determined based on athletes' sprinting capabilities and their proficiency in baton exchanges.
 
• **Javelin Throw:** Requires strength, technique, and precision, and is categorized as a field event. Athletes like Neeraj Chopra dedicate their training to excelling in this specific sport.
 
• **National Records:** Setting national records in athletics showcases the progress and talent in Indian sports, encouraging further development and international recognition.
 
• **Tokyo Olympics 2020:** Neeraj Chopra's gold medal win was a landmark achievement for Indian athletics, inspiring future generations of athletes.
